description: The Stirling number of the second kind S(n,k), the number of ways to partition n objects into k nonempty unlabeled sets. S(5,2) is 15. S(n,k) is 0 when k is greater than n. n and k run from 0 to 80. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana).
